navigation_blocking_issue.root_cause_hypothesis: Portal routing logic (likely in App.js or portal-shell component) may be defaulting to Management Portal for users with multi-portal access, ignoring the 'portal' URL parameter. Possible issues: (1) Portal selection logic prioritizes Management over Marketing, (2) Deep-link portal parameter not being read correctly after login, (3) Session storage or localStorage may be caching last portal visited (Management) and overriding URL parameter
fix_suggestions: Check App.js or PortalShell.jsx for portal routing logic - ensure URL portal parameter takes precedence over cached portal preference
For users with multi-portal access, deep-link portal parameter should override any default or cached portal selection
Add console logging to portal routing logic to debug which portal is being selected and why
Test with user that has ONLY Marketing Portal access (not multi-portal) to isolate if issue is specific to multi-portal users
